source.title: Observed poleward shift of the South Equatorial Current and associated thermohaline variations in the South Pacific subtropical gyre
source.license: CC BY4.0 stated on original PDF1

source_reported_support.southern_branch_definition: South of10S under this paper convention; not automatically identical to other publications branch labels.

measurement_limits: Core movement is not alongflow length or crossflow width.
Figure2 bars retain author period1960-2020. Do not infer an annual series or exact start/end displacement from them.
Adjacent mean contours compare1960-1989 and1990-2020; the latter is31 calendar years. Preserve original endpoints instead of silently changing dates.
Transport integration limits10-30S and0-1000m are analysis bounds, not current edges or thickness.
Figure2g zero-contour depth is not specified in its caption; no current axis, footprint or physical-state join is extracted.
IAP grid resolution is1degree; finer plot-reading precision does not improve physical resolution.
